preconditions.description: Number of test cases T is between 1 and 1000.

preconditions.expression: all(1 <= N <= 10**5 and 1 <= M <= 10**5 for N, M in zip(Ns, Ms))
preconditions.description: For each test case, lengths N and M of strings S and A are between 1 and 100,000.

preconditions.expression: all(S[i] in {'?', 'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for S in Ss)
preconditions.description: Each character in string S is either '?' or from the set {a, b, c, d, e}.

preconditions.expression: all(A[i] in {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for A in As)
preconditions.description: Each character in string A is from the set {a, b, c, d, e}.

postconditions.expression: all(S_prime[i] in {'a', 'b', 'c', 'd', 'e'} for S_prime in S_primes)
postconditions.description: Each character in the resulting string S' is from the set {a, b, c, d, e}.

postconditions.expression: all(not is_subsequence(S_prime, A) for S_prime, A in zip(S_primes, As))
postconditions.description: A is not a subsequence of S'.

postconditions.expression: all(S_prime == '-1' or len(S_prime) == N for S_prime, N in zip(S_primes, Ns))
postconditions.description: If S' is not '-1', its length is equal to N.
